import customtkinter as ctk
from tkinter import filedialog
import threading

from validations.actuals_validator import run_validation as actuals_validation

# =====================================================
# APP SETTINGS
# =====================================================

ctk.set_appearance_mode("light")
ctk.set_default_color_theme("blue")

# =====================================================
# COLORS
# =====================================================

PRIMARY = "#2563EB"
SUCCESS = "#16A34A"
BACKGROUND = "#F8FAFC"

# =====================================================
# ROOT
# =====================================================

root = ctk.CTk()
root.title("Data Validation Hub")
root.geometry("1500x900")
root.minsize(1300, 800)

# =====================================================
# FILE STORAGE
# =====================================================

file_paths = {}

# =====================================================
# HEADER
# =====================================================

header = ctk.CTkFrame(
    root,
    height=90,
    fg_color="#0F172A",
    corner_radius=0
)

header.pack(fill="x")

title = ctk.CTkLabel(
    header,
    text="📊 DATA VALIDATION HUB",
    font=("Segoe UI", 30, "bold"),
    text_color="white"
)

title.pack(pady=(15, 0))

subtitle = ctk.CTkLabel(
    header,
    text="Enterprise Data Quality Platform",
    font=("Segoe UI", 12),
    text_color="#CBD5E1"
)

subtitle.pack()

# =====================================================
# MAIN CONTAINER
# =====================================================

main_container = ctk.CTkFrame(
    root,
    fg_color="transparent"
)

main_container.pack(
    fill="both",
    expand=True,
    padx=20,
    pady=20
)

# =====================================================
# LEFT PANEL
# =====================================================

left_panel = ctk.CTkFrame(
    main_container,
    width=450,
    corner_radius=15
)

left_panel.pack(
    side="left",
    fill="y",
    padx=(0, 15)
)

left_panel.pack_propagate(False)

# =====================================================
# VALIDATION TYPE
# =====================================================

validation_label = ctk.CTkLabel(
    left_panel,
    text="Validation Type",
    font=("Segoe UI", 18, "bold")
)

validation_label.pack(
    anchor="w",
    padx=20,
    pady=(20, 10)
)

validation_combo = ctk.CTkComboBox(
    left_panel,
    values=[
        "Actuals Validation",
        "Forecast Validation",
        "Inventory Validation"
    ],
    height=40
)

validation_combo.set("Actuals Validation")

validation_combo.pack(
    fill="x",
    padx=20
)

# =====================================================
# FILE PICKERS
# =====================================================

files_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(
    left_panel,
    fg_color="transparent"
)

files_frame.pack(
    fill="x",
    padx=20,
    pady=20
)

files = [
    "Sales File",
    "Item File",
    "UOM File",
    "Target File"
]

file_labels = {}

for file_name in files:

    ctk.CTkLabel(
        files_frame,
        text=file_name,
        font=("Segoe UI", 14)
    ).pack(
        anchor="w",
        pady=(8, 2)
    )

    row = ctk.CTkFrame(
        files_frame,
        fg_color="transparent"
    )

    row.pack(fill="x")

    label = ctk.CTkLabel(
        row,
        text="No file selected",
        anchor="w",
        height=35
    )

    label.pack(
        side="left",
        fill="x",
        expand=True
    )

    file_labels[file_name] = label

    def choose_file(name=file_name):

        file = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            filetypes=[
                ("CSV Files", "*.csv"),
                ("All Files", "*.*")
            ]
        )

        if file:
            file_paths[name] = file
            file_labels[name].configure(
                text=file.split("/")[-1]
            )

    btn = ctk.CTkButton(
        row,
        text="Browse",
        width=90,
        command=choose_file
    )

    btn.pack(
        side="right",
        padx=(10, 0)
    )

# =====================================================
# RUN BUTTON
# =====================================================

run_btn = ctk.CTkButton(
    left_panel,
    text="▶ Run Validation",
    height=50,
    font=("Segoe UI", 16, "bold"),
    fg_color=SUCCESS
)

run_btn.pack(
    fill="x",
    padx=20,
    pady=(15, 10)
)

# =====================================================
# STATUS
# =====================================================

status_label = ctk.CTkLabel(
    left_panel,
    text="Ready",
    font=("Segoe UI", 14, "bold"),
    text_color=PRIMARY
)

status_label.pack()

progress = ctk.CTkProgressBar(left_panel)

progress.pack(
    fill="x",
    padx=20,
    pady=15
)

progress.set(0)

# =====================================================
# RIGHT PANEL
# =====================================================

right_panel = ctk.CTkFrame(
    main_container,
    fg_color="transparent"
)

right_panel.pack(
    side="left",
    fill="both",
    expand=True
)

# =====================================================
# KPI CARDS
# =====================================================

kpi_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(
    right_panel,
    fg_color="transparent"
)

kpi_frame.pack(fill="x")


def create_card(parent, title):

    card = ctk.CTkFrame(
        parent,
        corner_radius=15,
        height=120
    )

    card.pack(
        side="left",
        fill="x",
        expand=True,
        padx=10
    )

    ctk.CTkLabel(
        card,
        text=title,
        font=("Segoe UI", 14)
    ).pack(
        pady=(20, 5)
    )

    value = ctk.CTkLabel(
        card,
        text="0",
        font=("Segoe UI", 32, "bold")
    )

    value.pack()

    return value


records_value = create_card(kpi_frame, "Records")
passed_value = create_card(kpi_frame, "Passed")
failed_value = create_card(kpi_frame, "Failed")
duration_value = create_card(kpi_frame, "Match %")

# =====================================================
# LOGS SECTION
# =====================================================

logs_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(
    right_panel,
    corner_radius=15
)

logs_frame.pack(
    fill="both",
    expand=True,
    pady=15
)

ctk.CTkLabel(
    logs_frame,
    text="Validation Logs",
    font=("Segoe UI", 20, "bold")
).pack(
    anchor="w",
    padx=20,
    pady=(15, 10)
)

log_text = ctk.CTkTextbox(
    logs_frame,
    font=("Consolas", 12)
)

log_text.pack(
    fill="both",
    expand=True,
    padx=20,
    pady=(0, 20)
)

# =====================================================
# LOG FUNCTION
# =====================================================

def add_log(message):

    log_text.insert(
        "end",
        str(message) + "\n"
    )

    log_text.see("end")

    root.update_idletasks()


# =====================================================
# VALIDATION FUNCTION
# =====================================================

def run_validation():

    try:

        required_files = [
            "Sales File",
            "Item File",
            "UOM File",
            "Target File"
        ]

        for file_name in required_files:

            if file_name not in file_paths:

                add_log(
                    f"Missing file: {file_name}"
                )

                status_label.configure(
                    text="Missing File"
                )

                return

        log_text.delete(
            "1.0",
            "end"
        )

        status_label.configure(
            text="Running..."
        )

        progress.configure(
            mode="indeterminate"
        )

        progress.start()

        add_log("=" * 60)
        add_log("ACTUALS VALIDATION STARTED")
        add_log("=" * 60)

        result = actuals_validation(
            file_paths["Sales File"],
            file_paths["Item File"],
            file_paths["UOM File"],
            file_paths["Target File"],
            log_callback=add_log
        )

        # KPI CARDS

        records_value.configure(
            text=f"{result['summary']['Records']:,}"
        )

        passed_value.configure(
            text=f"{result['summary']['Passed']:,}"
        )

        failed_value.configure(
            text=f"{result['summary']['Failed']:,}"
        )

        duration_value.configure(
            text=f"{result['summary']['Match %']}%"
        )

        add_log("")
        add_log("=" * 60)
        add_log("VALIDATION SUMMARY")
        add_log("=" * 60)

        for key, value in result["details"].items():

            add_log(
                f"{key:<25}: {value}"
            )

        add_log("")
        add_log(
            f"Excel Report Generated : "
            f"{result['output_file']}"
        )

        status_label.configure(
            text="Completed ✅"
        )

        progress.stop()
        progress.set(1)

    except Exception as e:

        progress.stop()

        status_label.configure(
            text="Failed ❌"
        )

        add_log("")
        add_log(
            f"ERROR : {str(e)}"
        )

# =====================================================
# THREAD RUNNER
# =====================================================

def run_thread():

    threading.Thread(
        target=run_validation,
        daemon=True
    ).start()

# =====================================================
# BUTTON EVENT
# =====================================================

run_btn.configure(
    command=run_thread
)

# =====================================================
# START APP
# =====================================================

root.mainloop()
